method: Read-only comparison of frozen project records with exact files from current official public Linux trees and a bounded public mailing-list query; no Linux tree retained and no build, VM, private source, capture, firmware or device access.

public_history.bounded_query: lore.kernel.org subject searches for MT6797 with CCCI, CLDMA and modem terms plus a broader t7xx review
public_history.negative_result_scope: No exact MT6797 CCCI/CLDMA submission appeared in the bounded subject queries; this is not an exhaustive historical absence claim.

t7xx_reference.subject: [PATCH net-next v8 04/14] net: wwan: t7xx: Add core components

reuse_map.component: WWAN core ports and netdev registration
reuse_map.boundary: Upper interface only; a proved MT6797 transport owns framing, channels, queues, firmware and hardware state.
Requires an existing RPMsg device and endpoint; neither is established for the MT6797 modem.
The 16-byte width and third-word channel/sequence/assert layout resemble the frozen MT6797 contract, but full word semantics, byte order, channels and handshake behavior are not proved compatible.

reuse_map.component: t7xx PCI, CLDMA, MHCCIF, modem FSM and DPMAIF
reuse_map.boundary: PCI probe/BAR/MSI-X/ATR and PM ownership, a 24-byte GPD, T7xx MHCCIF and DPMAIF do not match the frozen MT6797 APB CLDMA/CCIF contract with packed 16-byte descriptors.
Current binding and match data cover MT8183, MT8186, MT8188, MT8192 and MT8195 SCPs, not an MT6797 cellular modem.

dependency_ownership.required: Exact image identity and selection, authentication/placement owner, entry, boot acknowledgement, stop and crash behavior; redistribution rights remain separate.
Bootloader reservation provider, exact placement/size/feature layout, no-map and lifetime ownership.
Secure/boot/kernel programming authority, preserved state, 32 MiB remap behavior, rollback and release.
Clock/reset ordering, watchdog acknowledgement, warm/cold transitions, failure retention, shutdown and removal.
Registers, IRQs, SRAM exchange, flow control, boot/normal/exception/shutdown states and ordering.
Descriptor bits, queue roles, DMA mask/address encoding, coherency, barriers, completion/idle witness, unmap and recovery.
All four word semantics, byte order, versions, lengths, channels, ACK mapping and queue selection.
Only independently verified services map to standard WWAN port types and netdev; private vendor char/ioctl ABI remains out of upstream UAPI.

future_routes: Devicetree and ARM/MediaTek for any proved platform binding and resource owner
remoteproc only if the proved modem firmware lifecycle fits remoteproc
netdev/WWAN for standard control ports and data devices
upstream.t7xx_role: overlap reviewer, not presumed MT6797 platform-hardware owner
upstream.authorship: No author identity, DCO certification, maintainer agreement or submission readiness established.
upstream.local_patch_removal_condition: No local kernel patch exists. Any future temporary transport is removable only when an accepted upstream equivalent covers the same proved hardware identity, transport and lifetime contract.

verdict.smallest_safe_topic: Source-pinned architecture record only; code or binding would be unused or would freeze unproved resource/protocol assumptions.
eventual_implementation_gate: firmware selection, bootloader reservations and image placement
power, clocks, reset and watchdog sequencing
CCIF boot, normal, exception and shutdown states
CLDMA descriptor bits, address width, DMA/cache/barrier rules and positive idle/completion witnesses
CCCI framing, channel/queue mapping and orderly/crash teardown

must_join: exact modem image and shared-memory regions
lifetime owner and release condition for every region and protection effect
next_discriminator.required_quality: Each link must have attributable source evidence; names and offsets alone do not establish the handoff.
next_discriminator.failure_result: Missing or contradictory attribution retains the exact stop and admits no mapping, binding or platform driver.

later_gates: CLDMA queue and DMA completion contract
full power and CCIF boot, orderly-shutdown and crash-teardown state machine
verdict.reassessment_order: Run only the reservation-and-protection audit next. If it passes, address the later transport lifecycle gates; only after the framing subset is proved and real callers exist, reassess a common 16-byte CCCI helper.

limitations: The bounded public-history query is not an exhaustive proof of historical absence.
Structural resemblance of CCCI-named headers is not wire-compatibility evidence.
No current-source review proves hardware behavior or firmware rights.
No build was run because no code changed and compilation cannot resolve missing protocol or ownership evidence.
